## Inclusion bar (CONTRIBUTING.md §2)

- [ ] On-topic for Capella or the Arcadia method (not general MBSE only)
- [ ] Substantive — not pure marketing
- [ ] Link is live (CI link-checks it; you can pre-check with the Docker one-liner in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Not a duplicate (canonical-URL rule, CONTRIBUTING.md §6)
- [ ] Publicly accessible — linked, not re-hosted; not a banned host (`arcadia-method.com`, `capella.polarsys.org`, legacy eclipse Capella paths)

## Entry format (CONTRIBUTING.md §3–§4)

- [ ] `- [Name](url) - Description ` + inline-code tags + `(YYYY).` — hyphen separator, **not** an en/em-dash
- [ ] Description ≤ 140 characters
- [ ] Tags drawn only from the vocabulary, in the fixed order (language → method → tool → has-model → type → spec/standard → paid → year)
- [ ] `(YYYY)` is the resource's most recent author-published version
- [ ] If `has-model`: it's a directly downloadable, non-paywalled Capella model (`.aird` project) that opens in Capella (CONTRIBUTING.md §3)

## Housekeeping

- [ ] If a **top-level** section was added/renamed, updated the hand-maintained `## Contents` ToC
- [ ] (If a JGS product) it sits next to ≥1 competing/alternative entry (CONTRIBUTING.md Editorial neutrality)
